temporal.learned_models: Not testable temporally: no earlier complete district-total lag/target pairs. Spatial fits use 2024 labels and are not temporal validation.

uncertainty.method: Reporting-unit bootstrap of temporal persistence errors; tiny sample, no prospective coverage guarantee

forecast_intervals.method: Empirical bootstrap of pooled signed two-year count errors
forecast_intervals.assumptions: Same two-year horizon; errors exchangeable across districts and stable in time. Neither assumption validated. No neighbourhood uncertainty claim.

reason: Simplest valid temporal baseline. Learned candidates lack earlier lag/target pairs for temporal comparison; night context and matching geography are missing.

bias.reason: No matched police-district population, area or verified adjacency. Administrative wards are not interchangeable with police districts.
bias.jurisdiction_check: See city holdouts and per-city temporal metrics; one district per Haryana/UP city, no reporting-rate identification.

sensitivity.missing_context: unknown risk; annual persistence retained as historical research index
sensitivity.missing_time_labels: neutral assumed factors, no time training
sensitivity.percentile_effect: Common time multipliers change volume indices but do not change within-band area ordering.
